title: Kỹ năng viết trong quan hệ công chúng

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the role of controlled and uncontrolled information in PR activities and their impact on business communication. Develop writing skills for various media types, especially for press releases and news articles. Apply writing skills to build positive relationships between organizations and their publics.
Enhance written communication skills for various media types, including email, memos, and reports. Improve ability to communicate effectively through written content.
Understand ethical responsibilities in PR writing and maintain professional integrity.
Analyze and solve problems related to PR activities, including crisis management and event organization.
Conduct research to gather information for PR activities and develop strategies based on findings.
Manage PR projects, including planning, execution, and evaluation.
Lead group projects and presentations effectively, ensuring all team members contribute and collaborate.
Utilize digital tools and platforms for PR activities, including social media and websites.
Prepare and deliver effective presentations on PR topics.
Work collaboratively in teams to develop and present PR strategies and solutions.
